definitions.explanation: The ability to control or influence others, especially through official or institutional means. Often refers to political or governmental power.

examples.japanese: {権力|けんりょく}を{握|にぎ}る。
{権力|けんりょく}の{乱用|らんよう}は{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: Abuse of power is not permitted.

examples.japanese: {権力|けんりょく}を{持|も}つ{者|もの}は、その{責任|せきにん}も{負|お}うべきである。
examples.english: Those who hold power should also bear the responsibility.

notes:
{権力|けんりょく} refers to power in the sense of control or authority, especially political power.

FORMS:
{権|けん} (right, authority) + {力|りょく} (power) = power/authority

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {権力|けんりょく}を{握|にぎ}る: to seize power
- {権力|けんりょく}を{持|も}つ: to hold power
- {権力|けんりょく}を{行使|こうし}する: to exercise power
- {権力|けんりょく}の{乱用|らんよう}: abuse of power
- {権力|けんりょく}{争|あらそ}い: power struggle
- {権力|けんりょく}{者|しゃ}: person in power

COMPOUNDS:
- {国家|こっか}{権力|けんりょく}: state power
- {行政|ぎょうせい}{権力|けんりょく}: executive power
- {司法|しほう}{権力|けんりょく}: judicial power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {力|ちから}: power, strength (general)
- {権威|けんい}: authority, prestige
- {勢力|せいりょく}: influence, power (of a group)
